_about: Every file that still puts a roll on record by hand, outside the one door for it (src/lib/dm/roll-record.ts recordRoll): how many times it stores one (insertRoll), sends one (a publish of "roll_result") and adds one to a turn's cards (a push or other write onto rollIds, or joinStoredTurn), and the family of sites it moves onto the door with. A site moved is struck off, so the counts only go down; `total` is their sum. A send through a file's own wrapper is counted once, where the wrapper is written; a new site in such a file still shows, because it has to store its roll. Held by scripts/test-roll-record-sites.mjs; `node scripts/test-roll-record-sites.mjs --counts` prints what the source holds now.

families.requests: A roll a person asked for outright (the dice tray, the GM's roll table), a parked roll put on record as it lands, and a secret roll sent again once it comes out.

_rows: The rows of scripts/test-enforce-sweep-dice-sites.mjs whose call stores a roll that fails a check of its record, and which checks: home (the roll is on no turn and no line, so the chronicle never shows its card), sent (dice the seat entered are on record and sent as the server's, so the stage throws them again), roller (an attack or damage roll names nobody, so it reads as the roll of the character it lands on; or a roll nobody made names a source that does not say what it is, says that source a second time, or does not name the character it lands on). Each is a site in `sites` above that has not moved onto recordRoll yet. A row is struck off when it passes; `ODM_SWEEP_ROWS=print node scripts/test-enforce-sweep-dice-sites.mjs` prints the list as it stands.
